newsitem.title: USA: FORD NAMES VW EXEC AS EUROPE PRODUCTION CHIEF.
newsitem.headline: FORD NAMES VW EXEC AS EUROPE PRODUCTION CHIEF.

text.p: Ford Motor Co said it named former Volkswagen AG executive Rolf Zimmermann as General Operations Manager - European Manufacturing, a newly created position.
Zimmermann, 50, was most recently president of VW Navarra S.A. in Spain and has served as chief production officer for Skoda, VW's Czech automotive unit.

Zimmermann will be responsible for all of Ford's engine, transmission, body and assembly plants, and all manufacturing support functions in Europe. He also will oversee a number of facilities in North and South America and the Asia-Pacific area, Ford said.

He will report to John Huston, vice president - Powertrain Operations, to W. Dale McKeehan, vice president - Vehicle Operations, and as a member of the Ford Business Management Committee to Keith Magee, vice president - European Sales Operations.

Zimmerman, 50, was born in Russelsheim, Germany, has a degree in Mechanical Engineering from the Technical College at Wiesbaden and also has attended the GMI Institute in Flint, Mich., and the Harvard Business School.
